environments.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

sampling.precision: fp32 or fp64 sample arithmetic/output; pose and host affine float64

material_basis.storage: Each channel is cast once to float32 after the declared float64 calculation
material_basis.meaning: Deterministic nonnegative algebraic fields derived from CT values

spectra.interpretation: Declared test coefficients; coefficients/weights/response cast float32 once

cotangents.central: ones on rows[5R//16:11R//16],columns[5C//16:11C//16], zero elsewhere; divide by L1 norm
cotangents.dense: ones over detector; divide by number of pixels
cotangents.signed: sin(2*pi*u + phase0)*cos(3*pi*v + phase1), u/v linspace(-1,1), phases from numpy.random.default_rng(case.seed).uniform(-pi,pi,2); divide by L1 norm
cotangents.storage: Chosen output precision, then reused identically in objective and VJP

configuration.pose: Fixed nonidentity anchor and right-tangent direction in gradient_contract.json

timing.event_stream: Current Torch CUDA stream shared by Warp workspaces
timing.boundary: Resident native operations with destination resets; complete Torch iteration includes validation/allocation; output files written after timing
timing.correctness_order: Baseline and candidate correctness gates run before timing; failed baseline FD remains unresolved

numerical_thresholds.cotangent_normalisation: sum(abs(detector cotangent))=1 except the all-zero case

units.scalar: dimensionless optical depth or its directional derivative per unit declared step
units.material: expected photons per pixel, L1-normalised detector cotangent; path pairing is in the same objective units
units.paired: componentwise atol + rtol*abs(frozen baseline); identical precision, storage, rays and requested gradients required

numerical_thresholds.torch_gradient_storage: Field storage and returned field gradient are FP32 in both arithmetic modes; compare Torch gradient with native gradient cast to FP32 using modes.fp32.paired.volume_gradient.

selection.definition: Geometric mean of nonzero FP64 complete-iteration speedups; exact-zero controls excluded
selection.regression_interpretation: Regression flags require explanation or rejection
